userStories.title: install-weekly creates and loads the plist
acceptanceCriteria: On macOS, `praxis install-weekly` generates ~/Library/LaunchAgents/co.praxis.weekly.plist with the day/time from config and loads it via launchctl
Exit code 4 is returned if launchd installation fails

userStories.title: uninstall-weekly removes the plist
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis uninstall-weekly` unloads and deletes the plist
Running uninstall-weekly when the job is absent exits 0

userStories.title: macOS notification via osascript
acceptanceCriteria: When `--notify` is passed, the run posts a notification via `osascript -e 'display notification ...'` after writing the HTML
Notification title is 'Praxis weekly read is ready'

userStories.title: Notification includes trajectory label and never crashes the run
acceptanceCriteria: The notification body includes the digest's trajectory label (e.g., 'Drifting this week')
If osascript fails for any reason, the run logs the failure and still exits 0

userStories.title: Non-macOS prints snippet and exits cleanly
acceptanceCriteria: On non-macOS platforms, install-weekly does not attempt to schedule anything
The equivalent systemd timer or Task Scheduler XML is printed to stdout and saved to ~/.praxis/install-weekly-snippet.txt
